title: Speculation that Kirkpatrick was read into the legacy program

tellings.quote: and you know there's speculation that he was uh read into the legacy program and

plain: Sean Kirkpatrick, who ran AARO (the Pentagon office set up in 2022 to look into unexplained aerial reports), is said by some to have been briefed into the "legacy program," a secret effort said to hold recovered non-human craft. Kurt McConnell, a former Senate staffer, raises this with Michels only as speculation he has heard, and does not say who started it. If true, it would mean the man running the official inquiry knew about the very program it was meant to find.
